gaps.lead: The mechanic is servicing my car tomorrow.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.

gaps.lead: My grandfather planted all these apple trees.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who planted' identifies the agent with a relative clause.

gaps.lead: I only understood the joke much later.
gaps.explanation: After 'only + time phrase' at the front, invert: Only much later did I understand.
suggest + -ing (or suggest that + clause): suggested having.

gaps.lead: She is too young to drive.
He started playing golf at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ golf at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby/sport): took up golf.
